context:
Goal: the lane lint brings main into a lane's pull request, so runner 10's ready mark moves no head (your ruling on item 925 d).
Problem (rule): the auto-mode allow entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" (settings.json; docs/decisions/auto-mode-owner-acts.md line 88) says `--lane-lint` only reads and posts one comment, in any session, and the change makes it push a merge commit to the pull request branch when that head is in the caller's checkout; your ruling own-lane-lint-allow-b (2026-11-15 11:30 CST) covers that entry and that act only, so a push is a variant and needs your word.
Based on (ruling): own-lane-lint-allow-b (owner, 2026-11-15 11:30 CST).
Based on (measured): pull request #3552 at live head cf739ee02 had a sonnet round-1 review that failed on this (lane lane-lint-merges-main, 20:06 CST Nov 17, not re-run by triage).
Departs from: main — `--lane-lint` only reads and posts one comment — a change makes it push a merge commit to a pull request branch.
Waiting on: the lane fixes the review's other findings and does not touch the entry; its review record cannot be posted until a review passes.

options.gain: Your ruling on item 925 d works as built, with no flag.
options.how: The entry and the decision text change so the push needs no prompt. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo
options.label: Amend the allow entry and auto-mode-owner-acts so `--lane-lint` may push the main-in merge to the caller's own lane branch
options.lose: An auto-allowed call now writes to a branch.

options.how: The entry stays as ruled; the main-in flow passes the new flag and the flag is asked each time.
options.label: The push needs a new flag, `--lane-lint <pr> --merge-main`, outside the entry, so each push asks (recommended)
options.lose: One more prompt per lane, and the 925 d flow must pass the flag.

reply: Closed. You picked a: the allow entry and decision auto-mode-owner-acts are amended so --lane-lint may push the main-in merge to the caller's own lane branch. Routed to lane lane-lint-merges-main.
short: Lane lint pushing a merge commit: flag or amend

title: A change makes the lane lint push a merge commit to the lane's branch, but your allow entry says it only reads: should the push have its own flag or should the entry change?
why: b keeps your allow entry exactly as you ruled it, and a widens an auto-allowed call to write to a branch. Recommended by the lane, not owner-typed.
